2610.06823.title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
2610.06823.paper_summary: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.
2610.06823.paper_summary_zh: 大型縱向隊列通常包含手腕加速度計數據，但不包括光學心率感測，這促使我們從已在睡眠中收集的運動信號中恢復心臟信息。我們提出了SeqSmoother，一種基於Transformer的時間校正器，用於從手腕加速度計估計睡眠心率（HR）。SeqSmoother結合了頻譜描述符、中間的Nightbeat衍生頻率錨和一種物理驅動的次諧波特徵，旨在識別諧波頻率鎖定。所有推理時間的特徵均來自手腕加速度計，而ECG僅用於構建參考HR標籤和訓練標籤質量權重。我們使用13個參與者不重疊的保留折疊來評估SeqSmoother，並在匹配的60秒窗口和15秒步長協議下將其與官方Nightbeat實現進行比較。在所有的折外預測中，SeqSmoother達到了1.60 bpm的參與者宏觀MAE。在Nightbeat保留的匹配區間中，Nightbeat的絕對誤差低於SeqSmoother（0.615對比1.091 bpm），而SeqSmoother在合格錄音的更大部分提供了估計；Nightbeat為72.85%的SeqSmoother合格的折外網格生成了最終估計。另一方面，所提出的次諧波比率在識別參考定義的諧波鎖定候選者方面達到了0.972的AUROC。這些發現揭示了學習的時間建模和質量門控信號處理之間的準確性與可用性權衡，同時為識別基於加速度計的睡眠HR估計中的頻率跟踪失敗提供了經驗支持，這是一種物理知識驅動的方法。
